Original description

First described in 1892:

Drosera praefolia Tepper, Bot. Centralbl. 13(50): 353. 1892

IPNI record

How well the identifier knows it

Of 18 validation photos of Drosera praefolia (photos the model never trained on), its top guess was right for 12. It gave a confident answer for 11 of them, and 11 of those were right.

Only 38 training photos: species with fewer than 40 are identified less reliably.

Most often mistaken for

  • Drosera tubaestylis (2 photos)
  • Drosera stenopetala (1 photo)
  • Drosera minutiflora (1 photo)
